mcp_server/serena.tagline: Semantic, IDE-grade code tools for agents
mcp_server/serena.overview: Serena is a free, open-source coding toolkit that gives an LLM IDE-like abilities such as semantic code retrieval, editing, and refactoring at the symbol level. Instead of working with raw line numbers or plain text search, your agent understands the code's structure, which makes it faster and more reliable on large codebases. It connects to any MCP client.
capabilities: Finds and navigates code by symbols, not just text
Performs semantic edits and refactors like renames and moves

Cross-file renames and reference lookups without manual hunting

capabilities: Creates, modifies, and deletes 3D objects in a scene
Applies and edits materials and colors

Ask the assistant to create or modify objects in the scene
